resources.title: Lookup Function Decision Cheat Sheet
resources.description: VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and XLOOKUP side by side — which can look left, which defaults to exact match, which survives an inserted column — plus the IFNA-vs-IFERROR rule for not hiding a genuinely broken formula behind a friendly 'Not found' message.

resources.title: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS & AVERAGEIFS Quick Reference
resources.description: The exact argument order for all three -IFS functions (the sum/average range always comes first), a worked multi-condition example against this vault's own sample sales dataset, and why this beats a helper-column workaround.

resources.title: Regional Sales Transactions Sample Dataset
resources.description: A 50-row sample sales dataset (OrderID, OrderDate, Region, SalesRep, ProductID, Quantity, UnitPrice) spanning five months and four regions — built to practice lookups, SUMIFS, PivotTables, and dynamic array functions against, without needing a real company's data.

resources.title: Product Catalog Lookup Table Sample Dataset
resources.description: A small 5-row product lookup table (ProductID, ProductName, Category) that pairs with the Regional Sales Transactions dataset — the second table needed to practice XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH enrichment and a Power Query Merge, the same way a real fact table and dimension table pair up.

resources.title: Power Query Cleaning Steps Checklist
resources.description: A repeatable cleaning order (types before splits before filters, before combining) built around the Applied Steps model, plus the one question that decides Merge vs. Append — the most common Power Query mix-up analysts make.

resources.title: Chart Type & Goal Seek Decision Guide
resources.description: The five questions a chart actually answers (comparison, trend, composition, relationship, distribution) mapped to the right chart family, plus Goal Seek's three required fields and how it differs from a Data Table.
